hypothesis: A conservative subset of score-approved, non-certified Polymarket/Kalshi contract pairs can offer positive terminal carry after pricing same-risk-class resolver mismatch and reserving shared portfolio capital.

v1_exclusion.reason: V1 budgeted each candidate against $500 independently and pooled agreement risk across heterogeneous rule classes.

selection_disclosure.historical_use: Settled pre-registration matches initialize only the same frozen category/structure/mismatch-class agreement prior.
selection_disclosure.mismatch_treatment: Every mismatched settlement is assigned zero bundle payout, even where the selected direction would actually pay one or two dollars.

frozen_mechanics.independent_unit: match_id + direction + UTC entry day; inference clusters again by event family and UTC day
frozen_mechanics.risk_class: Polymarket category + Kalshi category + structured contract form + sorted mismatch reason codes
frozen_mechanics.prior_estimator: 95% Wilson lower bound on all-contract agreement within each event-family cluster, estimated inside the same risk class
frozen_mechanics.book_requirements: synchronized fresh A/B data and A/B execution fidelity
frozen_mechanics.portfolio: $500 total and $250 per venue reserved across every unresolved v2 entry; settlement release may lag by one prior-refresh interval
frozen_mechanics.sizing: equal shares over executable full L2 depth using only unreserved portfolio cash
frozen_mechanics.hurdle: same-class agreement-lower-bound payout minus executable asks minus entry fees minus a second fee layer minus one adverse tick per leg minus full modeled immediate-orphan unwind reserve must be positive

evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across both terminal-carry versions, the complete cross-venue family, and every prior searched strategy.
evaluation.promotion: No automatic live path. A passing read triggers a separate 50-fill authenticated pilot review at $1-$2.
evaluation.null_outcome: No quote may clear the conservative hurdle, or measured forward edge may be approximately zero.
